item.title: See it: Fourth meteor sighting in one week caught on camera in Michigan
item.description: For the fourth time in a week's span, skywatchers witnessed a meteor streaking across the sky in the U.S.

item.title: Record-breaking heat wave causes breathtaking Death Valley superbloom to peak early this year
item.description: The National Park Service advised that the intense heat and high winds have led the wildflower superbloom to already reach its peak. This was Death Valley National Park's best wildflower bloom since 2016.

item.title: NASA pauses Gateway lunar-orbit space station to build lunar base on the moon
item.description: NASA announced a series of plans regarding lunar exploration on Tuesday, including that the previously-planned Gateway Space Station is being paused to support a base on the moon's surface.

item.title: What is an exoplanet and what makes one habitable?
item.description: The universe contains many surprises and opportunities, including the phenomena of exoplanets.

item.title: Search and rescue crews save two climbers stuck on high ledge at an Oregon state park
item.description: First responders were called to a high-elevation rescue of two climbers who were stuck on a ledge 400 feet in the air at an Oregon state park.

item.title: NASA's Artemis program: Paving the way for humankind's return to the moon and beyond
item.description: Artemis II is capturing global attention—but it’s only the next stride in NASA’s accelerating campaign to return humans to the Moon and beyond. Here's how five missions will set the stage for a lunar landing and deep space exploration this decade.

item.title: NOAA launches new weather forecast system to improve air travel safety
item.description: NOAA will utilize a new weather forecasting system starting in March to improve the prediction of aviation hazards that pose risks to flight safety, including airplane icing and turbulence.

item.title: Grand Canyon National Park enters Stage 3 water restrictions following another South Rim pipe break
item.description: Following a water pipeline break along the North Kaibab Trail, Grand Canyon National Park has implemented Stage 3 water restrictions on the South Rim beginning April 1.

item.title: Rainfall and extreme snow depths trigger trail instability and closures
item.description: Recent rainfall and overnight precipitation have prompted Killington Resort to close the Superstar Six lift and the Superstar Trail on Wednesday until further notice, following an assessment of snowpack instability.

item.title: New Hawaii beach advisory issued for high bacteria after historic flooding
item.description: Hawaii's State Health Department issued a beach warning for increased levels of harmful bacteria, more than a week after back-to-back storms triggered devastating flooding across the state.

item.title: NOAA unveils mobile radars to speed up storm warnings and protect lives
item.description: On Monday, NOAA unveiled three new radars that will provide much more detailed, real-time data than traditional fixed radar systems and can be deployed directly into severe weather.

item.title: See it: Dust storm creates apocalyptic red skies in Libya
item.description: A local state of emergency was issued for the city of Tobruk, Libya, after a dust storm turned skies a bright red.

item.title: Baby girl dies after being left in car in Florida
item.description: A 1-year-old girl died after being found in a car for an unknown amount of time in Florida on Tuesday.

item.title: Artemis II makes history, bringing humans around the moon for the first time in 50 years
item.description: Artemis II, the historic test flight taking four astronauts on a flyby around the Moon, has liftoff after months of preparation.

item.title: Artemis II brings pieces of the past on its historic deep space voyage
item.description: The Artemis II mission is seeking to make history while carrying a piece of aviation history with them onboard the Orion spacecraft.
